title: No test coverage; tests directory holds only an excluded .old file
description: Verified: the tests/ directory contains only tests.ps1.old, which does not match the Pester glob 'tests/*.ps1' used by package.json's test script (line 21). Effective automated coverage is 0%. No API method, validation branch, pagination, or filter behavior is tested, yet .aidd/spec.md's quality bar requires all features covered by tests in tests/.
notes: Resolved: a real Pester v5 suite (tests/pantry.Tests.ps1), discovered by `npm test` (Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/*.ps1), now covers the canonical pantry data model that replaced the deleted /api/crud demo domain. Coverage maps to each remediation step: list+name-sort+filter+search+pagination (Get-PantryItems/Select-PantryItems/Resolve-CrudPaging), create+missing-field validation (New-PantryItem/Test-PantryItemInput), update+validation (Update-PantryItem), and delete valid + unknown-id no-op + unknown-id read. Added this iteration: a delete-unknown-id no-op guard, an unknown-id read guard, and a dedicated SQL-injection safety Describe proving the DAL's @-parameter binding stores DROP/DELETE/boolean-injection payloads literally without executing them. The stale, glob-excluded demo file tests/tests.ps1.old (referencing the removed application/featureName/tag domain) was deleted per step 1. npm test => 65 passed / 0 failed (was 60); PSScriptAnalyzer on the test file adds no new findings.
spec:
Detailed remediation steps:
1. Add a real Pester v5 suite under tests/*.ps1 (rename/replace tests.ps1.old).
2. Cover each /api/crud method: GET (list + filter + pagination), POST (create + missing-field validation), PUT (update + validation), DELETE (valid + invalid id).
3. Include a negative test for SQL-injection-shaped input.
4. Ensure 'npm run test' discovers and passes the suite; keep it green in CI.
